div.head: Wi 6
div.ab: Gif priost læfe unriht hæmed oþþe fulwihðe untrumes forsitte oþþe to þon druncen sie, þæt he ne mæge, sio he stille his þegnungæ oþ biscopes dóm.
Gif priost læfe unrihthæmed, oþþe fulwih[t]e untrumes forsitte, oþþe to þon druncen sie þæt he ne mæge, sio he stille his þegnungæ oþ biscopes dom.

If a priest allows an unlawful union, or neglects the baptism of a sick person, or is so drunk that he is not able [to perform his duties], let him be inactive in his service pending the bishop’s decree.

If a priest consents to an illicit union, or if he neglects the baptism of a sick man, or is too drunk to discharge this duty, he shall abstain from his ministrations, pending a decision from the bishop.

Wenn ein Priester ein gesetzwidriges [Ehe-]Verhältniss zugiebt oder die Taufe eines Kranken versäumt oder so betrunken ist, dass er nicht [fungiren] kann, sei er seines [Pfarr-]Amtes enthoben bis zu des Bischofs Urtheilsspruche.

If a priest permits an unlawful [marriage] relationship or neglects the baptism of a sick person or is so drunk that he cannot [officiate], let him be suspended from his [parish] office until the bishop’s judgment.
